mapper.select: SELECT MAX(price) AS maxPrice, MIN(price) AS minPrice, sku_id, COUNT(sku_id) AS count, round( SUM ( price*qty ) / sum(qty), 2 ) avgPrice FROM so_detail WHERE is_deleted=FALSE GROUP BY sku_id

SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, sd.delivery_status, si.approve_status FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT sd.id, sd.main_id, sd.sku_id, sd.sku_no, sd.qty, sd.price, sd.tax_rate, sd.amount, sd.currency, sd.currency_symbol, sd.is_gift, sd.is_reissue, sd.is_close, sd.remark, sd.delivery_status, si.approve_status FROM so_detail sd INNER JOIN so_info si ON sd.main_id = si.id AND sd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE si.is_deleted = FALSE
